items.headline: Dormant Whale Moves $ASTER, $FF and $OP to Binance
items.summary: A wallet dormant for a year shifted about $444,700 in $ASTER, $FF and $OP from MEXC to Binance, sparking talk of a coming sell or major reposition.

items.headline: Coinbase Gold-Backed Loans Go Live via $MORPHO
items.summary: Coinbase is offering gold-backed borrowing built on $MORPHO infrastructure, opening a fresh DeFi lending use case beyond pure crypto collateral.

items.headline: $KAIA Stakers Told to Migrate Before Permissionless Upgrade
items.summary: $KAIA is asking stakers to migrate ahead of its permissionless network upgrade, a key step as the smaller L1 opens up validator access.

items.headline: $PYTH ARR Jumps 18.9% as Oracle Data Expansion Speeds Up
items.summary: $PYTH's October report shows ARR up 18.9% with faster data expansion, signaling rising demand for its oracle feeds across DeFi.

items.headline: $SOL Targets Hong Kong's Tokenization Market
items.summary: $SOL is positioning for Hong Kong's tokenization sector, chasing regulated RWA growth as the chain pushes deeper into institutional finance.
